start: A workout open on the phone, the watch connected, MettleUp on the watch

steps.action: Tap Complete set (on the phone or on the watch)
user_sees: A countdown ring with the time left, e.g. '1:30'
The exercise and set line, e.g. 'Set 3 of 5 · Bench Press'
Last time's numbers in grey and today's target in the accent colour
must_not: '0:00' while time is still left (0.2 s left still reads '0:01')

user_sees: 'Rest is over' on a full accent screen, with how long it has run over
must_not: A second buzz later in the set

start: Rest started from the phone; the watch shows the rest screen (view only)

steps.action: Start the rest on the phone and look at the watch
user_sees: The same countdown and next set line within a few seconds
must_not: Two different times on phone and watch
Buttons on a view-only rest screen that do nothing

start: Logging on the watch: the rest screen after Done shows -15 / +15 / Skip

must_not: The ring jumps back to full or the time changes by another amount

user_sees: The rest ends and the next set shows

start: The watch was away from the phone when a rest ended

steps.action: Come back in range more than 5 s after the rest ended
user_sees: No rest screen and no buzz; the next set shows
must_not: A buzz in the middle of the next set

start: A rest is running on the watch

steps.action: Tap Skip on the watch (or log the next set on the phone)
user_sees: The rest screen goes and the between-sets screen shows
must_not: The rest comes back or buzzes after it was skipped
The ring starting part-empty from the old rest

start: Member on the free plan with a Wear OS watch

user_sees: The rest counts down and buzzes on the watch
must_not: A paywall over the rest timer, which is promised free for everyone
